questions.question: After the Santhal Revolt (1855-56), the Santhal Pargana was created, carving out 5,500 square miles from which of the following districts?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhagalpur and Birbhum.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Santhal Pargana is the mainland of the famous Santhal rebellion. 
 
• Santhal Pargana was created, carving out 5,500 square miles from **Bhagalpur and Birbhum**.
 
• On 30 June 1855, two Santal rebel leaders, Sidhu and Kanhu Murmu with the help of Chand and Bhairav, mobilized ten thousand Santals and declared a rebellion against British colonists.
 
• Santhal Parganas comprised a district of the same name, in undivided Bihar state, India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• The Santhal uprising of 1855:__

 
 
• The Santhals were given land and persuaded to settle in the foothills of Rajmahal.
 
• By 1832 a large area of land was demarcated as Damin-i-Koh. This was declared to be the land of the Santhals. They were to live within it, practice plough agriculture, and become settled peasants.
 
• The land grant to the Santhals stipulated that at least one-tenth of the area was to be cleared and cultivated within the first ten years.
 
• The territory was surveyed and mapped. Enclosed with boundary pillars, it was separated from both the world of the settled agriculturists of the plains and the Paharias of the hills.
 
• After the demarcation of Damin-i-Koh, Santhal settlements expanded rapidly.
 
• From 40 Santhal villages in the area in 1838, as many as 1,473 villages had come up by 1851.

questions.question: Who among the following scholars was ordered by Sultan Muhammad bin Tughlaq in 1342 to proceed to China as his envoy to the Mongol ruler?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ibn Battuta.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• Ibn Battuta full name Muhammad Ibn Battuta was a Moroccan traveller who left his home at the young age of 21 back in the 13th century to travel across the world.
 
• During his 30 years of travelling exploration, he visited around 44 countries, including India.
 
• His travelling accounts are published in the book ‘Rehla’ written in Arabic, providing extremely rich and interesting details about the social and cultural life in the subcontinent in the fourteenth century, a part of which is devoted to his experience in India. 
 
• Ibn Battuta visited India in 1333 A.D. during the regime of Muhammad bin Tughlaq.
 
• Countries visited by Ibn Battuta:- Morocco, Mecca, Syria, Iraq, Persia, Yamen, Oman, China, India, Maldives, Sri Lanka, and Sumatra (Indonesia).
 
• Ibn Battuta considered experience gained through travels to be a more important source of knowledge than books.

questions.question: For which of the following decades did the percentage decadal growth of population in India register the sharpest decline since independence?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2001 - 2011.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The percentage decadal growth of the population during 2001-2011 has registered the sharpest decline since independence.

questions.solution:

⇒ 120 - 27over100 × 120 = 87.6

Finally, the number is increased by 10%

Net change in the number = 96 - 100 = -4

∴ There is a net decrease of 4% in the number.

questions.question: The ratio of the incomes of A and B is 2 ∶ 3 and the ratio of their expenditures is 5 ∶ 7. If 7 times the income of A is equal to 6 times the expenditure of B, then what is the ratio of the savings of A and B?

**Given:**

Ratio of income of A and B = 2 : 3

Ratio of expenditure of A and B = 5 : 7

**Concept:**

Savings = Income - Expenditure

**Calculation:**

Let the income of A and B be 200 and 300 respectively.

According to the question-

7 × Income of A = 6 × Expenditure of B

⇒ 7 × 200 = 6 × Expenditure of B

⇒ Expenditure of B = 7over 6 × 200 = 700over 3

⇒ Savings of A = 200 - 500over 3 = 100over 3

SP = Selling Price

CP = Cost Price

G = Gain%

Gain = SP - CP

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of each toy be Rs 1.

⇒ Total cost price = Rs 1 × 120 = Rs 120

Total SP of 45% toys = Rs 1.4 × 45over 100 × 120 = Rs 75.6

Total toys remaining = 120 - (54 + 22) = 44

According to the question-

Total SP of remaining toys = Rs 44 - Rs 14 = Rs 30

Total cumulative SP = Rs 75.6 + Rs 26.4 + Rs 30 = Rs 132

Gain = Rs 132 - Rs 120 = Rs 12

G = 12over 120 × 100 = 10%

∴ **The net profit % is 10%.**

Vandana said to me, "I don't want to buy the same dress as yours."

options.text: Vandana told me that I don't want to buy the same dress as yours.
Vandana told me that I didn't want to buy the same dress as hers.
Vandana told me that she didn't want to buy the same dress as mine.
Vandana told me that she doesn't want to buy the same dress as mine.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** "Vandana told me that she didn't want to buy the same dress as mine."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the grammatical structure of the given direct speech sentence and the answers given in the options.
 
 
• **Here Vandana **is talking so "**Vandana" **is the reporter.
 
• "**Said to " **is the reporting verb.
 
• "**me" **is the listener.
 
• "**I don't want to buy the same dress as yours" **is the reported speech narrated by "**Vandana".**
 
• Hence, The type of sentence of the reported speech is "**Assertive Sentence" So we have to apply the rules of Assertive Sentences.**
 
• "**Said to will be converted into told.**
 
• **"That" **Conjunction is used When Assertive Sentence is converted into Indirect Speech.
 
• In the Reported Speech "I" refers to Vandana. Vandana is a third-person Singular So It will be converted into She.
 
• **Present tense (Negative) **is converted into **Past Tense (Negative).**
 
• "**Me" **(is the objective case). "**Yours"** is the **possessive Pronoun** case.
 
• So, "**Yours" **is used for me and the **Possessive Pronoun case for Me is "Mine".**
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option no 3.

questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. However, physical fitness and a stubborn fearlessness never let a climber fail.

B. The equipment can be made so light that no extra energy is spent in carrying it.

C. To a large extent, the physical difficulties can be reduced by paying attention to the equipment.

D. It is certain that weather plays an important part in the success or failure of mountain climbers.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is:** DCBA**.

 
• The paragraph tells us that there is little doubt that the weather has a significant impact on mountain climbers' success or failure (D). Paying close attention to the equipment can greatly decrease the physical challenges (C). It is possible to make the equipment so light that carrying it requires no additional energy (B). However, a climber's physical preparedness and unyielding lack of fear ensure success (A).
 
• As we can see, it is the perfect chronological order of the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **DCBA**.

• **Example:- **He always asks unrelated questions.

• **Example:- **Priya has been facing a puzzling situation as She has to choose between her own career or her Family.
